question: Explain the concept of place of effective management (POEM) for determining the residential status of a company.
sources: Income-tax Act, 1961, section 6(3) and its Explanation
CBDT guiding principles for determination of place of effective management (2017 circular)

points.label: When a company is resident
points.description: A company is resident in India if it is an Indian company, or if its place of effective management in that year is in India.

points.label: Meaning of POEM
points.description: The place where key management and commercial decisions necessary for the conduct of the business as a whole are, in substance, made.
points.basis: Income-tax Act, 1961, Explanation to section 6(3) (meaning of place of effective management)

points.label: Active business outside India
points.description: For a company engaged in active business outside India, POEM is presumed to be outside India if the majority of its board meetings are held outside India.
points.basis: CBDT guiding principles on POEM: companies engaged in active business outside India

points.label: Other companies
points.description: Otherwise, identify the persons who actually make the key decisions and where those decisions are made; substance prevails over form and one-off decisions are not decisive.
points.basis: CBDT guiding principles on POEM: companies other than those engaged in active business outside India
